messages:
Sofia (partnerships): heads up 30 vendor note from NordicRack: manifest CS-NR-55 has an incorrect tariff descriptor. customs flagged it and there's a 72h hold risk for our EU reserved racks.
Tom (logistics): 72h hold will push several installs. which regions are affected? we have UK and NL depots expecting those racks next week.
Lars (NordicRack): apology team 30 we found a typo on the BOL description. wrong HS segment. current declares as 'electronic machines' instead of 'data processing units'. carrier put a soft hold pending docs. we're reissuing corrected BOLs now.
Priya (sales): customers impacted? we promised on-site for BetaWave and EdgeGrid in week 42. BetaWave is strict. need mitigation plan.
Tom (logistics): mitigation options: 1) request expedited corrected docs + customs release (24-48h if accepted) 2) route those containers to alternate EU depot to avoid local install misses (adds trucking 1-2 days) 3) cover canary from marketplace pool as overlap.
Rafael (infra): option 3 is best for zero downtime for BetaWave. can we spin up 1 rack from Redwood Marketplace in the region and pre-configure it? need serial mapping to keep telemetry and cost attribution consistent.
Lars (NordicRack): NordicRack can provide unit-level serials and firmware tags immediately. we'll push CSV and amended BOL into the partner portal in ~15m.
marketplace-bot: Marketplace allocation available: RK-MKT-GB-01 (2 racks), RK-MKT-NL-02 (1 rack). To request: run `marketplace reserve --sku RK-MKT-GB-01 --qty 1 --hold-token PEND-NR55`
Sofia (partnerships): quick ask: can marketplace reserve be conditional (no charge unless used) so finance doesn't get surprised? also need to confirm SLA parity (firmware, same network racking).
marketplace-bot: Conditional hold supported for 72h with token PEND-NR55. SLA parity: customer-facing hardware parity guaranteed for same SKU family.
Tom (logistics): I'll accept a conditional hold for 1 rack in GB and 1 in NL as buffer. that + corrected BOL should cover BetaWave and EdgeGrid. can NordicRack commit to same-day electronic BOL update?
Lars (NordicRack): yes, we will push corrected BOL and a signed amendment by EOD. will include HS code: 84713000 and a preset manifest note: "data processing machines - rack-mounted".
Priya (sales): i'll notify BetaWave that we're deploying a priority canary from marketplace if customs delay occurs. wording: "temporary parity rack from Redwood Marketplace will be used to ensure your launch window; final hardware will follow once customs clears."
Rafael (infra): tech checklist for canary swap (will run once serials land in Console): 1) import CSV via `redwood-console ingest --file canary-nr55.csv` 2) map serial->rack, attach firmware label 3) run 3 smoke traces + KV priming. target: complete within 3 hours of reservation.
Tom (logistics): action dependency: need Cisco-certified trucking for GB depot. I'll start quotes and hold provisional slot until NordicRack confirms amended docs.
Sofia (partnerships): Lars, please confirm ETA for the portal upload and the corrected BOL. also confirm whether NordicRack can cover expedited customs brokerage fee if docs were their error.
Lars (NordicRack): uploading corrected BOL and CSV now (portal: /partners/nordic/CS-NR-55/). we can cover brokerage fee up to 300 per container as a gesture.
Priya (sales): that's great. i'll include that in the customer note. BetaWave reply expected: they want confirmation within 2 business hours or they'll escalate to their purchasing team.
Tom (logistics): note: if customs refuses electronic correction, fallback is to offload at first EU port and cross-dock to GB trunk which adds ~24h. I'm rebooking provisional cross-dock slot as contingency.
marketplace-bot: Reservation executed: HOLD-2565 created for RK-MKT-GB-01 x1 and RK-MKT-NL-02 x1 (conditional token PEND-NR55). Expires in 72h.
Rafael (infra): once Nordic CSV arrives, I'll import the serials and tag them with metadata: vendor:NORDIC, manifest:CS-NR-55, hold_token:PEND-NR55.
Sofia (partnerships): summary/todo: (A) NordicRack to upload corrected BOL + unit CSV (Lars) (B) Tom to finalize provisional trucking and cross-dock quotes (Tom) (C) Rafael to import serials and prep canary image (Rafael) (D) Priya to send BetaWave customer comms with contingency wording (Priya) (E) Marketplace conditional hold is active (system)
Tom (logistics): :thumbsup: provisional trucking started, cross-dock slot held (t+1h to confirm).
Rafael (infra): :thumbsup: will start import when CSV available. aiming for canary ready in <3h after import.
Priya (sales): :thumbsup: drafting message now. will ping BetaWave legal if they ask for the brokerage note.
Lars (NordicRack): :thumbsup: BOL + CSV uploaded. portal link: https://partners.nordicrack.com/CS-NR-55/docs. invoice amendment pending.
marketplace-bot: Document uploaded: CS-NR-55/corrected_bol.pdf by Lars.
Sofia (partnerships): thanks team 41 please react when your item is done. i'll post the final partner playbook snippet to #eng-logistics and #support once all acks come in.
